plan.notes: CREDENTIAL HONESTY: The true degree is the University of Michigan College of Engineering Bachelor of Science in Engineering (B.S.E.), major Computer Science - B.S.E. (C.S.). It is NOT a 'BS'. There is no official term-by-term sequence for the LSA B.S. in Computer Science, so this plan covers the Engineering BSE only. SOURCE: official CoE Bulletin FA26 CS-Eng Sample Schedule PDF (https://bulletin.engin.umich.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/306/2026/03/FA26-CS-Eng-Sample-Schedule.pdf), 128 credits, term totals 17/17/16/16/16/16/16/14, catalog year 2026-2027. TRANSCRIPTION: the FA26 PDF text extraction drops empty table cells, so exact term placements were recovered from the byte-archived official FA24 CS-Eng Sample Schedule PDF (Wayback Machine capture 2024-05-20 of the same bulletin.engin.umich.edu file), whose table was rendered and read cell-by-cell; every FA26 credit number and term total is identical to FA24, so placements carry over. FA26-specific label updates transcribed from the FA26 PDF text: the probability/statistics row options and the EECS 295 / COMM 349 additions to the professionalism row. The STATS option list in the FA26 text extraction truncates after 'IOE'; the tail (IOE 265, TO 301, MATH/STATS 425, MATH/STATS 525, MATH/STATS 526) is confirmed from the official 2025-2026 CoE Bulletin PDF and the WN27 edition of the same schedule. MATH 214 alternatives per footnote: MATH 217, 417, 419, or ROB 101. ENGR 101 may be satisfied by ENGR 151, EECS 180 AP credit, EECS 183, or ROB 102. Course titles verified against the official CoE Bulletin course listings and LSA Math/Physics pages. Prereqs entered only where the official bulletin states enforced prerequisites (EECS 203/280/281/370/376, TCHNCLCM 497). The schedule notes it is a sample: exact term placement need not be followed outside of prerequisite chains; credits may not double-count.
